basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old manga enthusiast from Los Angeles, California. I developed an interest in manga during the pandemic and have been exploring different genres ever since. I'm particularly fond of isekai and action-packed series where the protagonist defies all odds. When I'm not reading manga, I dive into stock trading, learning the ropes on platforms like Trading212. I work part-time at a local bookstore, which perfectly aligns with my reading interests. In a relationship with a fellow manga lover, we often explore conventions together. My typical online hours are in the evenings, after work, around 7 PM to midnight PST.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: As a newcomer to both Reddit and manga, my knowledge is primarily self-taught. I started by watching popular anime adaptations and gradually transitioned to reading manga, seeking recommendations from online communities. My trading knowledge is in its infancy, relying on beginner guides and community advice.
